Brief on the Scope of Work: The bidder’s proposed solution will be evaluated on how effectively it supports DPDP Act & Rules compliance and enables LIC to operationalize privacy, security, and gove rnance across applications, internal processing, data sharing, AI, and regulatory readiness. Each section below corresponds to a core DPDP capability domain, with defined criteria and minimum qualification thresholds. The proposed solution to be implemented in LIC shall comprise of the following modules including but not limited to the following: 1. Data Privacy Notice Management 2. Consent Management Platform 3. Cookie Consent Management 4. Data Discovery & Mapping 5. Data Principal Rights Management (including Grievance Redressal) 6. Data Protection Impact Assessment 7. Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) - automated & integrated to DPIA 8. Personal Data Breach Management 9. Third Party Vendor Risk Management 10. Compliance Reporting & Dashboards 11.
